input: Create a color-coded family chore rotation calendar

gold.taskTitle: Build a Color-Coded Family Chore Rotation Calendar
gold.taskDescription: Create a visual, color-coded calendar that rotates household chores among family members on a recurring schedule.

questions.title: How many family members will be assigned chores?
questions.description: Understand the total number of people included in the rotation so colors and assignments can be planned accordingly.

questions.title: What specific chores need to be on the calendar?
questions.description: Get a complete list of household chores the user wants to track and rotate among family members.

questions.title: Should the rotation cycle weekly, biweekly, or monthly?
questions.description: Determine the frequency of the chore rotation to structure the calendar layout correctly.

questions.title: Will children be assigned chores alongside adults?
questions.description: Clarify whether the calendar needs age-appropriate task separation or different rules for kids versus adults.

questions.title: What format should the final calendar be in?
questions.description: Find out whether the user wants a printed paper calendar, a digital spreadsheet, an app, or another format.

questions.title: Should each person have one color assigned to them?
questions.description: Confirm whether colors represent individual people, chore categories, or something else entirely.

questions.title: Is there a specific start date for the calendar?
questions.description: Establish when the chore rotation should begin so the calendar can be built around the correct timeline.
